remake.swap: 1) the scooter DRIVER (white short-sleeve mesh shirt, dark shorts) becomes the Shiba Inu from image 1 (Shiba head, furry Shiba legs and round paws); 2) the SHIRTLESS REAR PASSENGER becomes a fluffy golden retriever with a fully furry body; he holds a big grey plastic drum/bucket up on his shoulder with one raised front leg, which exposes his underarm; 3) the hand that holds the vanilla ice-cream bar coming in from the right edge becomes one furry dog paw; 4) the bystander becomes a real dog
remake.ending: Right after the crash, in the same sunny street next to the tipped-over scooter and the rolled grey trash bin, the same Shiba Inu in the white mesh shirt sits on the pavement, its fur and shirt smeared with melted white ice cream and dust; it pulls one wet wipe out of the pink pet wet-wipe pack (the real product from the image, pink pack with a navy lid) and briskly wipes the ice cream off its muzzle and chest, the pack standing upright on the ground right beside it with the label facing the camera; the golden retriever sits dazed in the background.
remake.sub:
독일 더마 테스트 완료한 펫티슈로
떡짐과 비린내 엉킴까지 말끔하게
remake.vo: 겨드랑이 맛은... 닦으면 끝. 구매는 프로필 링크에서.

beats.text: Photorealistic handheld phone footage behind a moving black scooter on a sunny road lined with green hedges. The golden retriever passenger keeps holding the big grey plastic drum up on its shoulder with its raised front leg the whole time. [0.0-1.5s] the dog paw entering from the right edge rubs the vanilla ice-cream bar back and forth in the fur under that raised leg, three quick rubs. [1.5-2.2s] the retriever grimaces and turns its head away. The Shiba driver keeps riding in front. No cuts.

Photorealistic handheld phone footage on the moving scooter. [0.0-1.2s] the Shiba driver in the white mesh shirt twists its head back toward the camera and laughs hard with its mouth wide open, shoulders shaking, paws on the handlebars. No cuts.

Photorealistic handheld phone footage on the moving scooter, close on the Shiba driver. [0.0-0.5s] the Shiba laughs with its mouth open; the dog paw pushes the vanilla ice-cream bar straight into its open mouth. [0.5-1.0s] the Shiba bites down on the bar. [1.0-2.0s] it keeps the bar in its mouth, chewing, still unaware, riding forward. No cuts.

Photorealistic phone footage, wide shot on a sunny pavement by green hedges. [0.0-1.0s] the black scooter wobbles left and right as the disgusted Shiba driver loses control. [1.0-1.8s] it tips over sideways onto the pavement; the golden retriever behind loses its grip and the big grey plastic drum falls and rolls on the ground. [1.8-2.4s] both dogs tumble beside the fallen scooter. No cuts, camera steady.

board_notes: golden retriever passenger on the back seat holding a big grey plastic drum up on its shoulder with its raised front leg; a furry dog paw from the right rubs a small neat vanilla ice-cream bar into the fur under that raised leg; the retriever grimaces; the Shiba driver in the white mesh shirt rides in front. Tidy ice cream, no dripping liquid.
the Shiba driver in the white mesh shirt turns back toward the camera laughing with its mouth wide open, furry paws on the handlebars; the retriever with the grey drum on its shoulder behind.
extreme close-up: the furry dog paw presses the squashed vanilla ice-cream bar into the golden retriever's underarm fur; part of the grey drum visible above. Funny, tidy, no dripping liquid.
the furry dog paw pushes that same vanilla ice-cream bar into the open laughing mouth of the Shiba driver (white mesh shirt).
close-up of the Shiba driver's face scrunching up in disgust the moment it tastes the ice cream: eyes squeezed shut, mouth wide open in a grimace with the ice-cream bar in it, white mesh shirt.

wide shot: the black scooter wobbling and starting to tip over sideways on the pavement, the Shiba driver leaning, the golden retriever behind it losing grip of the grey plastic drum which is falling; green hedges, sunny.
